sloka: वानरान् वानरैरेव जघ्नुस्ते रजनीचराः।राक्षसान् राक्षसैरेव जघ्नुस्ते वानरा अपि ।। ६.६९.५८ ।।
transliteration: vānarān vānaraireva jaghnuste rajanīcarāḥ।rākṣasān rākṣasaireva jaghnuste vānarā api ।। 6.69.58 ।।

translations.english: The monkeys struck at the Rakshasas taking the weapons left over and tearing the weapons of the Rakshasas and the Vanaras also struck the Rakshasas.
